content: Timɣarin i isexxaren i Yasuɛ
Awarni uya icuq Yasuɛ di tneddam d dcurat, ittbarreḥ s Tgeldit n AREBBI. Tuɣa akides tenɛac n rrusul nnes,
uřa d temɣarin aya nni tuɣa ittwassgenfan zi řeḥřacat u zi řaryaḥ iɛeffanen: aqa-tt Maryam, qqaren as ‘tenni n Majdala’, i zi ttwassuffɣen sebɛa n ccwaṭen,
d Yuḥanna, tamɣart n Xuza, awkiř n Hirudus, d Susanna, d tinneɣni aṭṭas i tuɣa ttsexxarent xasen s wagřa nsent.
Amedya n umzarreɛ
Řami din issmun ijj n řɣaci d ameqqran, usin-dd ɣares zi marra tineddam, inna s yijj n umedya:
“Iffeɣ-dd ijj n umzarraɛ, ḥima ad izarɛ zzariɛet nnes. Am izarreɛ, tewḍa cwayt n zzariɛet deg webrid, iɛfes xas uca neqben i-tt ijḍaḍ.
Tewḍa cwayt n zzariɛet nneɣni x weẓru, umi dd-teɣmi deɣya, tuẓeɣ, minzi war ɣares tuɣi tuffet.
Tewḍa cwayt n zzariɛet nneɣni di řwesṭ n isennanen uca isennanen ɣemyen-dd akides uca jeyyfen tt.
Tewḍa cwayt n zzariɛet nneɣni di temmurt yareḍben d lemliḥ, uca umi dd-teɣmi, tegga řɣiǧet n mya imuren.” Awarni řami tuɣa iqqar man aya, iřaɣa: “Wenni ɣar iǧa imezzuɣen i useǧi, ejj i-t ad iseř.”
Sseqsan t imeḥḍaren nnes: “Min ixs ad yini umedya-a?”
Inna asen: “I kenniw umi immewc ad tessnem ssirr n Tgeldit n AREBBI, maca i inneɣni ad dd-yas wawař s imedya, ařami nitni ttwařan maca war ttwiřin uca ttesřan war fehhmen.
D wa d řmeɛna n umedya: zzariɛet nettat d Awař n AREBBI.
Ina x ṭṭarf n webrid, nitni d inni ittesřan Awař, maca xenni ittas-dd ibřis, ittekkes Awař zeg wuř nsen ařami war ttimnen uca ad ddaren.
Ina x weẓru, nitni d inni xmi ɣa sřen, ad qebřen Awař s řefraḥet, maca war ɣarsen bu weẓwar, ttamnen ɣar xennit, di řweqt n ujarreb ad nqarḍen.
Ina i iwḍan deg isennanen, nitni d inni ittesřan Awař, xenni ttraḥen, ttbuxsuyen deg imnusen d wagřa d ṭṭamuɛ n ddunect, war ssendayen ca řɣiǧet.
Ina di temmurt yareḍben, nitni d inni ittesřan i Wawař, xemmřen t deg wuř nican, iṣbeḥ, uca ssendayen řɣiǧet s ṣṣbar.”
Amedya n řefnar d řmerfeɛ
“Uřa d ijj war issruɣi řefnar uca iqebbar xas s yijj n uqedduḥ niɣ issrusa t sadu qama, maca s řemqřub issrusa t x řmerfeɛ, ḥima inni dd-ittadfen ad ẓaren tafawt nnes.
Minzi war din min idřin, war dd-itteffiɣ ɣar barra, u war din min innuffaren, war ittwissin, war dd-itteffiɣ ɣar barra.
Ḥḍam mammec tᵉttesřam, minzi wenni ɣar iǧa ad as immarni, u wenni war ɣar iǧi, min d as ittɣiř ɣares, ad zzayes ittwakkes.”
Man wen iǧan d yemmas d aytmas n Yasuɛ
Yemmas d aytmas usin-dd ɣares, war zemmaren ad akides ssiwřen s ssibbet n řɣaci.
Nnan as: “Yemmac d aytmac bedden barra, xsen ad Cek ẓaren.”
Yarra-dd, inna asen: “Yemma d aytma, aqa d inni ittesřan Awař n AREBBI u tteggen zzayes.”
Yasuɛ d tḥaryaḍt
Deg ijjen zeg wussan nni inya deg ict n tɣarrabut, Netta d imeḥḍaren nnes. Inna asen: “Ejj aneɣ ad neẓwa ɣar ujemmaḍin n řebḥar!”
Am ten tuɣa ruḥen di řebḥar, ikka yiḍeṣ x Yasuɛ. Xenni tehwa-dd ict n tḥaryaḍt n usemmiḍ di řebḥar, tebda tɣarrabut ɛřayen ad tehwa.
Qarrben ɣares uca ssfaqen t, nnan as: “A Amseřmad nneɣ, a Amseřmad nneɣ, aqa nɣarreq.” Netta ikkar-dd, iwebbex asemmiḍ d řemwaj n waman uca ssqaren, yarsa řḥař.
Xenni inna asen: “Mani iǧa l’iman nwem?” Ggʷeden, tbehten, nnan jar asen: “Min iɛna Wa, aqa ittamar uřa d asemmiḍ d waman uca ttᵉṭṭaɛen as.”
Asgenfi n ijj n umeryaḥ
Uyuren s tɣarrabut, usin-dd ɣar temmurt n Gadarinus tenni qibač i Ljalil.
Umi dd-iffeɣ ɣar temmurt, iřqa t-i-dd ijj n weryaz zi tendint. Aṭṭas zeg wami tuɣa dayes ijj n cciṭan u tuɣa war ittirḍ arruḍ, war izeddeɣ di taddart maca deg imeḍřan.
Umi iẓra Yasuɛ, isɣuy, iwḍa ɣar iḍaren nnes, inna s jjehd “Min din jar aneɣ necc d Cek a Yasuɛ, Mmis n AREBBI, Amɛuǧi x kuřci? Ttzawageɣ Cek, war d ayi tɛeddibed?”

Maɣar Netta yumur i řaryaḥ amengus, ḥima ad dd-iffeɣ zi bnadem nni, minzi tuɣa-t dayes ɛad ijj n řmijar n řweqt d ameqqran. Tuɣa arezzun ad t carfen s ssnaseř d iceddiyyen, maca netta tuɣa ittareẓẓa iceddiyyen nnes uca xenni yuẓẓeř xas ijj n cciṭan ɣar řexřa.
Isseqsa t Yasuɛ: “Mammec d ac qqaren?” Inna as: “Lixyun ”, minzi ccwaṭen aṭṭas tuɣa udfen dayes.
Nitni ttaren zzayes, ḥima war ten ittamar ad raḥen ɣar weḥfur.
Tuɣa din ict n tḥimart d tameqqrant n iřfan, tuɣa thedda deg wedrar. Ttaren zzayes ḥima ad ten ijj ad adfen deg iřfan. Uca Netta isamḥ asen.
Ffɣen ccwaṭen zi bnadem nni, udfen deg iřfan. Xenni teqnunni tḥimart zi jjarf di řebḥar uca tɣarq.
Umi ẓrin imeksawen min imsaren, arewřen uca ɛawden t di tendint u di dcurat.
Ffɣen-dd iwdan ḥima ad ẓaren min imsaren. Nitni usin-dd ɣar Yasuɛ, ufin bnadem nni zi ffɣen ccwaṭen, yarḍ, s řeɛqeř, iqqim ɣar iḍaren n Yasuɛ, uca ggʷeden.
Inni iẓrin man aya, ɛawden asen mammec ittwassgenfa umaryaḥ.
Řɣaci n Ijadariyyen zawgen t, ḥima ad xasen iggʷej, minzi tudef i-ten tiggʷudi temɣar. Xas uca yenya Yasuɛ di tɣarrabut, iggʷej xasen.
Aryaz i zi ffɣen ccwaṭen, ittar zzayes, ma ad taɣ izemmar ad ɣares iqqim, maca Yasuɛ issekk i-t, inna as:
“Ɛqeb ɣar taddart nnec, ɛawed i ayt bab n taddart min dayek igga AREBBI.” Xas uca iruḥ, ibarreḥ di qaɛ tandint s marra min dayes igga Yasuɛ.
Yeǧis n Yayrus d ict n temɣart teḥřec zeg usizzeř n idammen
Ařami dd-iɛqeb Yasuɛ, yareḥḥeb zzayes ijj n řɣaci d ameqqran, minzi marra ttrajan t.
U xzar, yusa-dd ijj n weryaz qqaren as Yayrus, tuɣa-t d ameqqran n temzida, iwḍa ɣar iḍaren n Yasuɛ uca izawg i-t ad yadef ɣar taddart nnes,
minzi ayenni n yeǧis i ɣares tenni ɣar iǧa tenɛac n iseggʷusa, tuɣa ɛřayen ad temmet. Am kides iggur Yasuɛ, issdeḥḥes i-t řɣaci.
Ict n temɣart, tuɣa ttazzřen zzayes idammen řqedd n tenɛac n iseggʷusa, tseyyar marra řeɛweč nnes x iḍbiben, war izemmar ḥed ad tt issgenfa,
tusa-dd ɣares zi ḍeffar, tḥada abeḥřuř n warruḍ nnes, uca řexdenni ibedd usizzeř n idammen nnes.
Xas uca Inna Yasuɛ: “Wi d ayi iḥadan?” Umi nkaren marra, inna Cimɛun Buṭrus d yinni akides: “A Amseřmad nneɣ, řɣaci issdeḥḥes i-c u Cek teqqared: ‘Wi d ayi iḥadan?’”
Maca Yasuɛ inna: “Aqa ijjen iḥada ayi, minzi Necc uciɣ jjehd iffeɣ zzayi.”
Umi tessen temɣart, belli war teqqim war temẓar, tusa-dd s uqefqef uca tewḍa ɣar iḍaren n Yasuɛ, isjed as. Qibač i marra iwdan txebbar x man ssibbet i zi t tḥada d mammec tᵉttwassgenfa deɣya.
Inna as Yasuɛ: “Egg uř, a yeǧi, aqa l’iman nnem iwca am Tudart. Ruḥ di řehna.”
Am issawař ɛad, yusa-dd ijj n weryaz zi taddart n umeqqran n temzida, inna as: “Aqa yeǧic temmut, war ssaḥař ɛad Amseɣɣar.”
Maca Yasuɛ isřa man aya, inna i babas n tḥenjirt: “War teggʷed ca! Amen waha, nettat ad teddar!”
Umi dd-yusa Yasuɛ ɣar taddart, war ijji uřa d ijjen ad yadef mɣir Cimɛun d Yaɛqub d Yuḥanna d babas n tḥenjirt d yemmas.
Tuɣa marra ittru, wtin xas agejdur. Netta inna: “War ttrum, nettat war temmut ca, maca nettat tᵉṭṭeṣ.”
Nitni ḍeḥcen dayes, ssnen belli nettat tuɣa temmut.
Maca awarni řami issuffeɣ marra, iṭṭef i-tt zeg ufus nnes, iřaɣa, inna as: “A taḥenjirt, kkar!”
Idweř-dd dayes buḥbeř uca tekkar řexdenni. Xenni yumur ad as wcen min ɣa tecc.
Tbehten lwalidin nnes, maca Netta iweṣṣa i-ten, war qqaren i ḥed min imsaren.
